desc: The Lessons hall (scripts/home/lesson_hall.gd): leave a Boki for a timed lesson; it comes back with a stat point or two and a new habit it shows while it stands about (KinHabit). Time runs on the clock, so a lesson finishes while the game is closed.
reach_doc: Tiles beyond the hall's edge from which you can press E at it.

song.name: Song
song.desc: Steady breathing and a steady voice: +2 Guard, and it hums while it stands about.

dance.name: Dance
dance.desc: Quick feet: +2 Speed, and it sways and hops when it feels like it.

drawing.name: Drawing
drawing.desc: Patient hands: +2 Focus, and it scratches little pictures in the dirt.

lessons_doc: Per lesson: stat (a Care.STATS key) gets gain points through Care.add_stat (the stat budget still caps it); habit is a KinHabit pose it learns; secs is the lesson's length; gems is the fee.
